'''Repulsorwagon''' was a class of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle. The [[JX40 Jailspeeder]] used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] was an example of a repulsorwagon.<ref name="HSatCSA" />
